verdict.rationale: LangGraph is a pip-installable, low-level orchestration library whose core features (scheduling, checkpointing, state management) live in the framework itself. Production persistence can use your own Postgres via PostgresSaver, and the LangGraph CLI builds and runs the Agent Server locally with its own database, so agents can run on your own infrastructure. A community question about production deployment beyond running `langgraph serve` locally is an open question, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a self-hosted production deployment path independent of LangSmith (the Agent Server/CLI docs sit under LangSmith), a stated open-source licensing/self-hosting guarantee, and independent hands-on corroboration of fully vendor-free production operation.
